title: Near Infrared Fluorescence Cholangiography (NIRF-C) During Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate an imaging system using Indocyanine Green (ICG) to assist in real-time identification of anatomy during cholecystectomy (gallbladder removal). We propose to define the effectiveness of NIRF-C in identifying the cystic duct junction during cholecystectomy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18-89
* Planned laparoscopic cholecystectomy

Exclusion Criteria:

* Inability to provide informed consent
* Pregnant
* Allergy to ICG, iodine, and/or shellfish
* Acute cholecystitis, cholangitis, and/or cirrhosis (main study)
* Lactating
